This team leverages the intense offensive pressure of Mega Golurk alongside the sun-setting capabilities of Torkoal to create a powerful offensive core. Mega Golurk, utilizing its **Unseen Fist** ability via the **Golurkite**, becomes a formidable physical attacker that can bypass protection moves. The team is designed to control the tempo of the match through weather and redirection/support roles.
